mapper.select: SELECT * FROM telemetry_floor_alarm_config ORDER BY floor_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_floor_alarm_config (floor_code, enabled, cooldown_minutes, notify_on_recovery, buffer_flush_minutes) VALUES (#{floorCode}, #{enabled}, #{cooldownMinutes}, #{notifyOnRecovery}, #{bufferFlushMinutes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), cooldown_minutes = VALUES(cooldown_minutes), notify_on_recovery = VALUES(notify_on_recovery), buffer_flush_minutes = VALUES(buffer_flush_minutes)
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_floor_alarm_config SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
